name: artbeat
description: Root convenience scripts. The real packages are in ./server and ./client — this file only forwards commands so they work from the repo root. Deliberately has no dependencies and no npm workspaces, so it cannot change how either package resolves its own node_modules.

scripts.dev: cd server && npm run dev & cd client && npm run dev & wait
scripts.install:all: cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.ios: cd client && npx cap open ios
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
scripts.typecheck: cd server && npm run typecheck && cd ../client && npx tsc --noEmit
